# 패키지

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(decontamSensitivity)
})
```

# DT 데이터 준비

```{r data}
project_dir <- "D:/KSY/Project/2.DT_Swab[논문작업pf남경화]/Rproj_DT_Swab"

phy <- readRDS(file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Phyloseq/phy_F270R240_260812_v3.rds"
))

metadata <- read.delim(
  file.path(project_dir, "metadata/DT_metadata.tsv"),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  inherits(phy, "phyloseq"),
  "sample_id" %in% names(metadata),
  "control_status" %in% names(metadata),
  !anyDuplicated(metadata$sample_id),
  setequal(sample_names(phy), metadata$sample_id)
)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_id
metadata <- metadata[sample_names(phy), , drop = FALSE]
metadata$control_status[
  metadata$control_status == "negative-control"
] <- "control"

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(metadata$control_status),
  all(metadata$control_status %in% c("sample", "control"))
)

sample_data(phy) <- sample_data(metadata)
phy
```

# 전체 threshold QC 실행

`thresholds`에 입력한 모든 값에 대해 표, 그림 및 필터링된 phyloseq 객체가
한 번에 생성된다. 별도의 selected threshold는 사용하지 않는다.

```{r run-qc}
qc <- run_decontam_qc(
  ps = phy,
  control_column = "control_status",
  control_label = "control",
  thresholds = seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1),
  taxonomy = "Genus",
  group_colors = c(
    total = "black",
    biological = "steelblue",
    control = "tomato"
  ),
  progress = TRUE
)

qc
```

# QC 표

```{r tables}
knitr::kable(
  qc$tables$threshold_summary,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Threshold별 read, ASV 및 sample retention"
)

knitr::kable(
  qc$tables$sample_retention_summary,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Threshold별 sample read retention 요약"
)

knitr::kable(
  qc$tables$library_size_summary,
  digits = 1,
  caption = "Sample과 control의 library size"
)

knitr::kable(
  head(qc$tables$flagged_taxa, 30),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Threshold별 flagged genus"
)
```

# 기본 QC 그림

```{r core-plots}
qc$plots$score_distribution
qc$plots$threshold_sensitivity
qc$plots$sample_retention
qc$plots$prevalence_enrichment
```

# Threshold별 flagged taxa read count

```{r flagged-taxa-plots}
for (threshold_name in names(qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads_by_threshold)) {
  plot_object <- qc$plots$flagged_taxa_reads_by_threshold[[threshold_name]]
  if (!is.null(plot_object)) print(plot_object)
}
```

# Threshold별 filtering 전후 taxa read count

```{r before-after-plots, fig.width=12}
for (plot_object in qc$plots$taxa_reads_before_after_by_threshold) {
  print(plot_object)
}
```

# Threshold별 phyloseq 객체

각 threshold의 필터링 결과는 같은 이름의 목록 원소로 저장된다.

```{r filtered-phyloseq}
names(qc$filtered_phyloseq_by_threshold)

filtered_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  names(qc$filtered_phyloseq_by_threshold),
  function(threshold_name) {
    phy_filtered <- qc$filtered_phyloseq_by_threshold[[threshold_name]]
    data.frame(
      threshold = as.numeric(threshold_name),
      samples = nsamples(phy_filtered),
      ASVs = ntaxa(phy_filtered),
      reads = sum(sample_sums(phy_filtered))
    )
  }
))

knitr::kable(filtered_summary)
```

# 결과 저장 예시

아래 코드는 필요할 때만 실행한다.

```{r save-results, eval=FALSE}
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "decontamSensitivity_output")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  qc$tables$threshold_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "threshold_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  qc$tables$flagged_taxa,
  file.path(output_dir, "flagged_taxa_by_threshold.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

for (threshold_name in names(qc$filtered_phyloseq_by_threshold)) {
  saveRDS(
    qc$filtered_phyloseq_by_threshold[[threshold_name]],
    file.path(output_dir, paste0("phy_decontam_", threshold_name, ".rds"))
  )
}
```
